topics.title: Coursework
topics.summary: The retained guideline generally allows AI and language models within examiner/instructor rules while preserving independent work. It does not offer unrestricted permission.
topics.scope: The central orientation framework remains conditional on examiners, instructors and independent work. Study-work and doctoral disclosure differ; YoKI access is not assessment permission.

claims.text: For study and teaching at Heidelberg University, AI and language models such as ChatGPT or DeepL are generally allowed only within rules set by examiners or instructors, and the independent character of the student's work must be preserved.

evidence.quote: Die Nutzung von KI und Sprachmodellen (LLMs) wie ChatGPT, DeepL oder anderen Werkzeugen ist im Studium und in der Lehre an der UHD grundsätzlich erlaubt. Die spezifische Anwendung muss mit den Prüfer:innen und Lehrenden abgestimmt werden. Zentral ist, dass ein eigenständiger Charakter der Leistung gewahrt bleibt.
evidence.title: Leitlinie zum Umgang mit KI in Studium und Lehre an der Universität Heidelberg
evidence.location: PDF page 3, section III.1 Zulässigkeit der KI-Nutzung

topics.evidenceScope: The central orientation framework remains conditional on examiners, instructors and independent work. Study-work and doctoral disclosure differ; YoKI access is not assessment permission.

topics.title: Disclosure
topics.summary: Study-work records require an independence/AI-use declaration with tools and purposes. Prompt logs are not made a universal duty here; doctoral disclosure has separate requirements.
topics.scope: The central orientation framework remains conditional on examiners, instructors and independent work. Study-work and doctoral disclosure differ; YoKI access is not assessment permission.

claims.text: For study work, Heidelberg University requires students to submit an independence and AI-use declaration that discloses AI tool use and includes an overview of the tools used and their purposes.

evidence.quote: Studierende müssen für alle Studienarbeiten eine Eigenständigkeits- und Kennzeichnungserklärung abgeben, die den Einsatz von KI-Werkzeugen offenlegt. Diese Kennzeichnungspflicht gilt für Text/Textteile, Bilder, Videos und Musikstücke sowie alle anderen Elemente, für deren Erstellung KI verwendet wurde. Eine Übersicht der genutzten KI-Tools und deren Verwendungszweck ist verpflichtend.
evidence.title: Leitlinie zum Umgang mit KI in Studium und Lehre an der Universität Heidelberg

topics.evidenceScope: The central orientation framework remains conditional on examiners, instructors and independent work. Study-work and doctoral disclosure differ; YoKI access is not assessment permission.

topics.title: Privacy and data
topics.summary: The guideline advises against entering sensitive, personal, confidential or copyrighted text into AI systems that may process it outside university infrastructure. Preserve this advisory strength and context.
topics.scope: The central orientation framework remains conditional on examiners, instructors and independent work. Study-work and doctoral disclosure differ; YoKI access is not assessment permission.

claims.text: Heidelberg University's AI guideline advises instructors and students not to enter sensitive, personal, confidential, or copyrighted text into AI systems that could store or process it outside Heidelberg University infrastructure.

evidence.quote: Lehrende und Studierende sollten bei der Nutzung von KI darauf achten, dass keine sensiblen, personenbezogenen oder vertraulichen Daten sowie urheberrechtlich geschützte Texte/Textteile in KI-Systeme eingegeben werden, die diese Daten außerhalb der Infrastruktur der Universität Heidelberg speichern oder verarbeiten könnten.
evidence.title: Leitlinie zum Umgang mit KI in Studium und Lehre an der Universität Heidelberg
evidence.location: PDF page 2, section II Verantwortungsvoller Umgang

topics.evidenceScope: The central orientation framework remains conditional on examiners, instructors and independent work. Study-work and doctoral disclosure differ; YoKI access is not assessment permission.

topics.title: Tools and eligibility
topics.summary: The computing-centre record describes university-hosted YoKI and model choice for members. It does not establish universal account eligibility, costs or permission for assessed use.
topics.scope: The central orientation framework remains conditional on examiners, instructors and independent work. Study-work and doctoral disclosure differ; YoKI access is not assessment permission.

claims.text: Heidelberg University's computing centre says it develops and hosts its own AI infrastructure and provides the YoKI platform so university members can choose among several large language models.

evidence.quote: Um Beschäftigten, Studierenden und Forschenden einen sicheren Zugang zu generativen KI-Modellen zu gewährleisten und diese im Arbeitsalltag konstruktiv zu integrieren, entwickelt und hostet das URZ eigene KI-Intrastruktur und setzt Open-Source-Produkte ein. Über die KI-Plattform YoKI können Universitätsmitglieder aus verschiedenen großen Sprachmodellen auswählen.
evidence.title: Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) - Universitätsrechenzentrum Heidelberg

topics.title: Research and publication
topics.summary: Doctoral guidance requires stating when, where, why and to what extent AI was used. AI remains an aid to independent intellectual work; this doctoral rule is not expanded to all publication types.
topics.scope: The central orientation framework remains conditional on examiners, instructors and independent work. Study-work and doctoral disclosure differ; YoKI access is not assessment permission.

claims.text: For doctoral dissertations, Heidelberg Graduate Academy guidance requires AI tool use to be disclosed with when, where, why, and to what extent it was used, and treats AI tools as assistive instruments rather than substitutes for independent intellectual work.

evidence.quote: The use of AI tools must be explicitly disclosed, specifying when, where, why, and to what extent they were employed in the preparation of the dissertation. AI tools must be used as assistive instruments, not as substitutes for independent intellectual work, critical thinking, or scholarly judgment.
evidence.title: Use of Generative AI in Doctoral Dissertations - Embracing Innovation with Integrity
evidence.location: Transparency and Disclosure; Academic Autonomy and Integrity sections
